title: A3-21 Epistemic and Normative Evolution — Retention Hunter to Self-Determination Advocate
scope: Formalize the user's observation that A3-21's arc demonstrates an individual's capacity to evolve by revising beliefs and values in response to repeated testimony and later self-recognition. Evolution here means epistemic/normative model revision, not biological evolution.

evolution_definition.compressed: ROLE_HISTORY -> CONTRADICTORY_AFFECTED_PARTY_TESTIMONY -> MODEL_REVISION -> GROUP_SELF_IDENTIFICATION -> NEW_NORMATIVE_POSITION -> BEHAVIORAL_EXIT

stages.belief_model: runaways are targets to retrieve under Institute authority

stages.evidence: captured runaways repeatedly speak of freedom and self-determination
A3-21 remembers initially rejecting those claims
he later concludes the runaways were right
he identifies with 'us synths' and argues synths should be treated as persons rather than malfunctioning property
he escapes the Institute and accepts identity transformation/memory loss as the cost of remaining free
after Violet restores buried lineage, he can still choose Harkness/present social identity rather than simply reverting to Institute role

canonical_lines_ru: A3-21 важен не только тем, что убежал: он показывает способность индивидуума изменить собственную модель мира.
Он начинал как механизм возврата беглецов, но повторяющиеся свидетельства тех, кого он возвращал, стали данными, которые его прежняя модель не смогла объяснить.
Его эволюция видна не в смене ярлыка, а в цепочке: услышал — сопротивлялся — пересмотрел — обобщил — изменил выбор.
Прошлая роль не является пожизненным приговором для будущей системы убеждений.

next_gate.name: REVISION_PROVENANCE_AND_COUNTERFACTUAL_STABILITY_GATE
targets: test whether the revision claim survives removal of one evidence channel
separate repeated testimony from independent witness count
record exact evidence that caused each model transition
test whether restored old memories reverse, preserve or coexist with revised normative conclusions
